high_level_description: The image shows a person standing in front of a backdrop with some text partially visible on the left side. The individual is wearing a bright red dress with thin straps and a deep V-neckline. The dress fits closely to the body, accentuating the figure. The person has long, wavy brown hair that falls over the shoulders. They have tattoos on both arms, one on each forearm. The backdrop appears to be part of an event or press conference, as indicated by the formal setting and the presence of another person dressed in a dark suit partially visible on the right side of the frame.
